text: 据同花顺iFinD数据，沪深京三市成交额超5000亿元，较上日此时放量859亿元，预计全天成交金额约3.0万亿元。截至目前，沪市成交额2237亿元，深市成交额2750亿元，北证50成交额30亿元。
text_en: According to Tonghuashun iFinD data, total turnover across Shanghai, Shenzhen, and Beijing markets exceeded 500 billion yuan, up 85.9 billion yuan from this time the previous day, with full-day turnover estimated at about 3.0 trillion yuan. Currently, Shanghai turnover is 223.7 billion yuan, Shenzhen 275.0 billion yuan, and BSE 50 index 3 billion yuan.
